en.card_get: $29/hr. Home daily. Local dry van in Joliet and the south suburbs.
en.card_need: Class A CDL. 2 years of experience. Age 23+.
en.primary_text: Local dry van runs out of Joliet. You're home every day, same dispatcher every day, and your truck is washed on Fridays. $29 per hour, Class A CDL, 2 years experience, 23+.
en.headline: Local. $29/hr. Home daily.
